blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Expanding multilingual ASR systems to new languages is challenging when adaptation must preserve previously supported languages without replaying source-language training data. We study this problem in connector-based Speech LLMs, where a trainable connector maps speech representations into a frozen large language model. We evaluate target-update construction and merging strategies for adapting the connector while preserving source-language performance. In single-target expansion, target-only fine-tuning and standard TIES merging learn new languages but cause severe source-language forgetting, while SSU-Wanda+TIES gives the best source-preserving trade-off. In multi-target expansion, update merging provides stable source retention, whereas recursive expansion can improve target adaptation under favorable orders but is highly order-sensitive. These results show that multilingual ASR expansion requires balancing target acquisition, source retention, and interactions among target-language updates.
blocks.zh: 将多语种ASR系统扩大到新语言具有挑战性,因为适应必须保留先前支持的语言,而不重放源语言培训数据。 我们在基于连接器的Speech LLMs中研究了这个问题,其中可训练的连接器将语音表达图映射为被冻结的大语言模型. 我们评价目标更新的构建和合并战略,以调整连接器,同时保持源语言性能。 在单目标扩展中,仅针对对象的微调和标准TIES合并学习了新语言,但导致严重源语言遗忘,而SSU-Wanda+TIES给出了最好的源保存取舍. 在多目标扩展中,更新合并提供稳定的源保留,而递归扩展可以在有利的订单下改进目标适应,但对于订单高度敏感. 这些结果表明,多语种ASR扩展需要平衡目标获取,源保留,以及目标语言更新之间的互动.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent speech foundation models have substantially improved multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) through larger training corpora, increased model capacity, and improved training objectives Babu et al. (2022) ; Radford et al. (2023) ; Barrault et al. (2023) . However, extending an existing multilingual ASR model to new languages remains challenging. Expansion often needs to be performed with limited data and computation while preserving performance on previously supported languages, creating a trade-off between target-language adaptation and source-language retention.
blocks.zh: 近期的语音基础模型通过更大的培训团队,增强模型能力,并改进培训目标Babu等人(2022年);Radford等人(2023年);Barrault等人(2023年)。 然而,将现有的多语种ASR模式推广到新语言仍然具有挑战性。 扩展工作往往需要利用有限的数据和计算,同时保留以往支持的语言的性能,在目标语言适应和源语言保留之间形成取舍。

blocks.en: A common expansion strategy is to fine-tune the existing model on the new language, but this can cause catastrophic forgetting. Similar degradation has been observed in connector-based Speech LLMs for ASR, where multilingual projectors are easy to adapt but may substantially harm original-language performance Concina et al. (2026a) ; Concina et al. (2026b) . Replay-based continual learning can mitigate forgetting by interleaving previously supported languages during adaptation, but it requires storing and reusing replay data. When such data is unavailable or impractical to reuse, expansion must rely on replay-free target-language adaptation without gradient-based source adaptation.
blocks.zh: 一个共同的扩展策略是将现有模式在新语言上进行微调,但这会造成灾难性的遗忘. 在基于连接器的ASRSpeech LLMs中也观察到类似的退化,其中多语种投影器容易被适应,但可能会对Concina等人(2026a)的原始语言性能造成重大伤害;Concina等人(2026b). 基于回放的持续学习可以通过在适应过程中将先前支持的语言互换来缓解遗忘,但它需要存储并再用回放数据. 当这种数据不可用或不切实际地重复使用时,扩展必须依靠不以梯度为基础的源的再播放目标语言适应。

blocks.en: Model merging offers an alternative by combining learned parameter updates without additional training Yang et al. (2026) . Methods such as weight averaging and task arithmetic integrate capabilities from different training runs or tasks in weight space Wortsman et al. (2022) ; Ilharco et al. (2022) , but independently learned updates may interfere. TIES-Merging mitigates this interference by removing small parameter changes and resolving sign conflicts between task vectors Yadav et al. (2023) . Language-specific merging has also been explored to reduce training and maintenance costs when adding or updating languages in multilingual models Dmonte et al. (2026) . However, how target-language updates behave in connector-based multilingual ASR expansion remains unclear, particularly without source-language replay during adaptation.
blocks.zh: 模型合并提供了一个替代方案,将学到的参数更新合并,而无需额外的培训 Yang等 (2026年). 重量平均和任务算术等方法结合了不同训练中的能力,在重量空间Wortsman等人(2022年);Ilharco等人(2022年),但独立学习的更新可能干扰. TIES-Merging通过去除小参数变化并解决任务矢量Yadav等(2023)之间的标志冲突来缓解这种干扰. 也探索了特定语言的合并,以减少在多语种模型Dmonte等人(2026年)中添加或更新语言时的培训和维护费用. 然而,目标语言更新在以连接器为基础的多语言ASR扩展中的表现仍然不清楚,特别是在适应过程中没有源语言重放.

blocks.en: In this work, we study source-aware multilingual ASR expansion for connector-based Speech LLMs Ma et al. (2025) ; Ma et al. (2024) . Starting from a multilingual base connector Zhang et al. (2026a) , our goal is to adapt the connector to new target languages while preserving performance on the source languages, without replaying source-language training data or performing gradient-based source adaptation during expansion. We focus on two questions: RQ1: How can adaptation and merging balance target acquisition and source retention? and RQ2: How effectively can independent target updates be merged to support multiple new languages?
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们研究了基于连接器的LLMS Ma等人(2025年);Ma等人(2024年)的多语种ASR扩展。 从多语种基础连接器张等(2026a)开始,我们的目标是在保留源语言性能的同时使连接器适应新的目标语言,而不会在扩展过程中重放源语言培训数据或进行梯度源适应. 我们侧重于两个问题: RQ1: 如何适应和合并平衡目标获取和源保留? 和 RQ2: 独立的目标更新如何能够有效地合并以支持多种新语言?

blocks.en: To answer these questions, we conduct controlled experiments with three multilingual base connectors and six target languages. We compare direct target fine-tuning, source-aware parameter-selective adaptation, and TIES-based target-update merging under the same target-language adaptation budget. Our experimental results suggest that source-aware merging substantially improves the adaptation–retention trade-off in single-target expansion, while multi-target expansion requires managing interactions among target-language updates. Joint update merging provides stable source retention, whereas recursive adaptation can achieve stronger target performance under favorable target orders.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这些问题,我们用三个多语种碱基连接器和六个目标语言进行受控实验. 我们比较了直接目标微调、源认识参数选择适应,以及基于TIES的目标更新合并在同一目标语言适应预算下。 我们的实验结果表明,来源意识的结合大大改善了适应-保留在单一目标扩展中的取舍,而多目标扩展则需要管理目标语言更新之间的相互作用。 联合更新合并提供了稳定的源保留,而再生适应则可以在有利的目标订单下实现更强的目标性能.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows. First, we introduce a source-aware multilingual ASR expansion setting for connector-based Speech LLMs, where new target languages are added while preserving existing source-language performance without source-language replay or gradient-based source adaptation. Second, we systematically compare target-update construction strategies, including direct fine-tuning, SSU-based parameter-selective adaptation, SSU+FT, and TIES-based target-update merging, to characterize the trade-off between target adaptation and source retention. Third, we extend the study from single-target to multi-target expansion and analyze how target-update interactions and recursive target order shape multilingual expansion.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下。 首先,我们为基于连接器的Speech LLMs引入了一种有源知识的多语种ASR扩展设置,其中添加了新的目标语言,同时保留了现有的源语言性能,而没有源语言重放或梯度源适应. 第二,我们系统地比较目标更新建设战略,包括直接微调、基于SSU的参数选择性适应、SSU+FT和基于TIES的目标更新合并,以说明目标适应与源保留之间的取舍。 第三,我们把研究从单一目标扩大到多目标扩展,并分析目标更新的相互作用和递归目标顺序如何形成多语种扩展。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multilingual ASR Expansion
blocks.zh: 2.1 多语种ASR扩展

blocks.en: Large-scale speech foundation models have advanced multilingual ASR through cross-lingual self-supervised learning, weakly supervised recognition, and unified multilingual speech modeling across diverse languages and tasks Babu et al. (2022) ; Radford et al. (2023) ; Barrault et al. (2023) . Recent LLM-based ASR systems further connect pretrained speech encoders with large language models through lightweight connectors, showing that frozen speech and language backbones can support multilingual recognition and benefit from auxiliary multimodal context Fathullah et al. (2023) ; Ma et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2024) . These developments motivate connector-based Speech LLMs as a parameter-efficient ASR framework, but leave open how to expand them to new languages while preserving existing multilingual capabilities.
blocks.zh: 大规模语音基础模型通过跨语言自我监督的学习,弱化监督的识别,以及跨越多种语言和任务的统一的多语言语音模型Babu等(2022年);拉德福德等(2023年);Barrault等(2023年)来推进多语言ASR. 最近基于LLM的ASR系统进一步通过轻量级连接器将预先训练的语音编码器与大型语言模型相接,显示被冻结的语音和语言主干能支持多语种识别,并受益于辅助多模式上下文Fathullah等 (2023); Ma等 (2024); Yang等 (2024). 这些发展激励了基于连接器的Speech LLMs作为参数高效的ASR框架,但留下了如何在保留现有多语种能力的同时将其扩展至新语言的开朗.

blocks.en: Multilingual ASR systems often need to be expanded after the initial model has been trained, making new-language acquisition and source-language retention a central challenge. Prior work on multilingual ASR expansion has largely framed new-language acquisition and forgetting as a continual-learning problem, covering replay-based retention, parameter-regularized adaptation, and decoder-specific optimization strategies Della Libera et al. (2024) ; Kwok et al. (2024) ; Concina et al. (2026b) . In contrast, our work does not rely on source-language replay or gradient-based source adaptation during expansion. We instead study how target-language updates can be constructed and combined under lightweight source-language calibration, comparing parameter-selective adaptation and target-update merging in both single-target and multi-target connector expansion.
blocks.zh: 多种语言的ASR系统在初始模式得到培训后往往需要扩展,使新语言的获取和源语言的保留成为中心挑战. 以往关于多语种ASR扩展的工作在很大程度上将新语种获取和遗忘作为一个持续学习的问题,涵盖基于重玩的保留、参数规范化的适应和针对代码的优化战略 Della Libera等(2024);Kwok等(2024);Concina等(2026b)。 相形之下,我们的工作在扩展期间并不依赖于源语言重放或梯度源的适应. 相反,我们研究如何在轻量级源语言校正下构建和合并目标语言更新,比较参数-选择性适应和在单目标与多目标连接器扩展中的目标-更新合并。

blocks.en: 2.2 Model Merging for Adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.2 适应合并模式

blocks.en: Model merging provides an alternative to continued fine-tuning by combining parameters or parameter updates from separately trained models. Model soups show that averaging the weights of multiple fine-tuned models can improve performance and robustness without increasing inference cost, particularly when the models are fine-tuned from the same initialization Wortsman et al. (2022) . Task arithmetic represents fine-tuning effects as task vectors and shows that these vectors can be added, subtracted, or composed to alter model behavior in parameter space Ilharco et al. (2022) . These approaches suggest that independently learned capabilities can sometimes be integrated without additional training.
blocks.zh: 通过将参数或参数更新与经过单独培训的模型相结合,模型合并提供了一种继续微调的替代办法. 模型汤显示,平均计算多个微调模型的重量可以提高性能和稳健性而不会增加推论成本,特别是当模型从相同的初始化Wortsman等人(2022)被微调出时. 任务算法代表了作为任务向量的微调效果,并表明这些向量可以被添加,被减去,或者被组成来改变参数空间Ilharco等(2022)中的模型行为. 这些方法表明,独立学习的能力有时可以在没有额外培训的情况下加以整合。

blocks.en: However, merging fine-tuned models separately can introduce interference between parameter updates. TIES-Merging addresses this issue by trimming small parameter changes, resolving sign conflicts among task vectors, and merging only sign-aligned updates Yadav et al. (2023) . In multilingual settings, Dmonte et al. (2026) study language-specific model merging as a way to reduce training and maintenance costs when individual languages are added or updated in multilingual task-specific LLMs. In the speech domain, model merging is explored for adding new tasks Zhao et al. (2026) ; Lin et al. (2025) , domains Carvalho et al. (2026) , and fairness Lin et al. (2026) ; Bravo-Bravo et al. (2026) . Nevertheless, existing model merging work has not fully examined connector-based multilingual ASR expansion under a source-free setting, where target-language updates must be integrated while preserving source-language performance without access to source-language data during expansion.
blocks.zh: 然而,单独合并微调模型可以引入参数更新之间的干扰. TIES-Merging通过缩小小参数变化,解决任务矢量之间的符号冲突来解决这个问题,并合并只有符号相通的更新雅达夫等 (2023). 在多语种环境中,Dmonte等人(2026年)研究了语言特有模式合并,作为在多语种特定任务LLMs中添加或更新个别语言时降低培训和维护成本的方法. 在语音领域,探索了模式合并,以添加新任务:赵等 (2026年);林等 (2025年),域名:Carvalho等 (2026年),和公平:林等 (2026年); Bravo-Bravo等 (2026年). 尽管如此,现有的模式合并工作并没有在无源设置下充分审查基于连接器的多语种ASR扩展,在扩展期间必须整合目标语言更新,同时保留源语言的性能而无法获得源语言数据.

blocks.en: 2.3 Parameter-Selective Adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.3 参数选择性适应

blocks.en: Parameter-selective adaptation aims to reduce forgetting by restricting which parameters are updated during task or language adaptation Liu et al. (2021) ; Zhang et al. (2024) ; Pan et al. (2024) . Instead of updating the full model, these methods identify parameters or structural units that are important for previously learned capabilities and protect them during subsequent fine-tuning. This idea has been explored in continual learning through masking, pruning, and parameter-isolation strategies, where different subsets of model parameters are assigned to different tasks or protected from future updates Mallya and Lazebnik (2018) ; Mallya et al. (2018) .
blocks.zh: 参数选择性适应的目的是通过限制在任务或语言适应过程中更新哪些参数来减少遗忘 刘等 (2021);张等 (2024);潘等 (2024). 这些方法没有更新完整的模型,而是确定了对以前学到的能力很重要的参数或结构单元,并在随后的微调中加以保护. 在通过遮掩、穿透和参数隔离战略不断学习的过程中探讨了这一想法,在这些战略中,不同的模型参数子集被分配到不同的任务中,或者保护不受未来更新的Mallya和Lazebnik(2018年);Mallya等人(2018年)。

blocks.en: Source-Shielded Updates (SSU) apply this idea to target-language adaptation of LLMs by estimating source-language parameter importance and freezing source-important units during target-language fine-tuning Yamaguchi et al. (2026) . This is particularly relevant to multilingual ASR expansion, where adapting to a new language can interfere with previously supported source languages. In our work, we adopt SSU-style source-aware masking for connector adaptation, using a lightweight source-language calibration set only to construct masks.
blocks.zh: Source-Shielded Updates (SSU) 在目标语言微调山口等(2026年)期间,通过估计源语言参数的重要性并冻结源重要单位,将这一想法应用于LLMs的目标语言适应. 这与多语种ASR扩展特别相干,适应新语言可以干扰先前被支持的源语言. 在我们的作品中,我们采用了SSU风格的源意识遮罩来适应连接器,使用轻量级的源语言校正装置来制造口罩.

SSU uses a small source-language calibration set to estimate which columns of each weight matrix are important for source-language behavior, and then freezes those columns during target-language adaptation. blocks.en: 4.2.1 Target Adaptation and Source Retention

blocks.en: Table 3: Macro-averaged WER (%) ↓ \downarrow for single-target expansion by base.

blocks.en: Table 3 reports macro-averaged WER for each base group. The results show a clear adaptation–retention trade-off. Target-only fine-tuning learns the new language effectively, but severely damages the original source languages. For example, on the Germanic base, Target FT reduces target WER from 102.70% to 27.86%, but increases source WER from 22.57% to 69.73%. The same pattern appears for Romance and Slavic, where source WER increases by +55.54% and +54.49%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表3报告每个基组的宏观平均WER。 结果显示了明显的适应-保留取舍。 唯目标微调能有效学习新语言,但严重损害了原始源语言. 例如,在德意志语基础上,目标FT将目标WER从102.70%减少到27.86%,但将源WER从22.57%增加到69.73%. 罗曼斯和斯拉夫语也出现了同样的模式,源WER分别增加了+55.54%和+54.49%.

blocks.en: Standard TIES merging does not solve this problem in the single-target setting. Although it preserves the target-language gains of fine-tuning, it retains most of the source-language degradation, behaving similarly to Target FT across base groups. SSU-Wanda+FT is also insufficient on its own, even with source-important parameters frozen during target adaptation, the resulting connector still suffers substantial source degradation. These results suggest that neither conventional merging nor protected fine-tuning alone is enough to recover a balanced source–target solution.
blocks.zh: 标准TIES合并并不能在单一目标设置中解决这个问题. 虽然它保留了微调的目标语言收益,但它保留了大部分源语言退化,与不同基组的FT目标类似。 SSU-万达+ 即便在目标适应期间冻结了源的重要参数,FT本身也是不够的,因此产生的连接器仍然受到源的大幅退化。 这些结果表明,无论是传统的合并还是受保护的微调,都不足以恢复平衡的来源-目标解决方案。

blocks.en: In contrast, SSU-Wanda+TIES gives the strongest overall trade-off. It keeps source WER close to the base connector while still improving target performance substantially. For Germanic and Romance, source WER increases by only +0.24% and +0.69%, while target WER drops from 102.70% to 35.82% and from 111.16% to 37.36%, respectively. For Slavic, the harder expansion setting, SSU-Wanda+TIES reduces source degradation from +53.95% under TIES to +6.68%, while improving target WER from 110.15% to 51.69%. These results show that strong single-target expansion requires combining source-aware adaptation with update merging.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,SSU-Wanda+TIES给出了最强的整体取舍. 它保持源WER与基接器相近,同时仍然能大幅度地提高目标性能. 对于日耳曼语和罗曼斯语,源WER只增加+0.24%和+0.69%,而目标WER分别从102.70%到35.82%和111.16%到37.36%. 对斯拉夫语来说,更难的扩张环境,SSU-Wanda+TIES将源降解率从TIES下的+53.95%降低到+6.68%,同时将目标WER从110.15%提升到 51.69%. 这些结果表明,强有力的单一目标扩展需要将对源的认识适应与更新合并结合起来。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Effect of Source-Aware Protection
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 源码保护的效果

blocks.en:
We next compare the three SSU masking criteria used with TIES: random masking, magnitude-based masking, and Wanda-based masking.
Table 3 shows that all SSU+TIES variants reduce source forgetting compared with Target FT and standard TIES, but they differ in how they balance target adaptation and source retention. SSU-Rand+TIES often preserves stronger target-language gains than SSU-Wanda+TIES, but leaves more source degradation. For example, on the Slavic base, SSU-Rand+TIES reaches 41.69% target WER, but increases source WER by +22.54%. SSU-Wanda+TIES gives a higher target WER of 51.69%, but reduces source degradation to +6.68%. This suggests that random protection can limit update damage, but does not reliably select the directions most important for preserving source-language behavior.
blocks.zh:
接下来我们比较了三个SSU口罩与TIES所使用的标准:随机口罩,量子口罩,和万达口罩.
表3显示,与目标FT和标准TIES相比,所有SSU+TIES的变体都减少了源被遗忘,但它们在如何平衡目标适应和源被保留方面有所不同. SSU-Rand+TIES经常比SSU-Wanda+TIES保存更强大的目标语言收益,但留下了更多的源降解. 例如,在斯拉夫语基础上,SSU-Rand+TIES达到了41.69%的目标WER,但将源WER增加了+22.54%. SSU-Wanda+TIES给出更高的WER目标为 51.69%,但将源降解降低到+6.68%. 这表明随机保护可以限制更新损害,但不能可靠地选择对维护源语言行为最重要的方向.

blocks.en: SSU-Mag+TIES provides a more structured mask than random selection, but it is generally worse than SSU-Wanda+TIES in source retention and overall WER. Across all three base groups, SSU-Mag+TIES causes larger source degradation than SSU-Wanda+TIES, indicating that weight magnitude alone is not sufficient to identify source-important connector directions. By incorporating source-language activations, SSU-Wanda produces a more conservative mask that better preserves the original multilingual capability.
blocks.zh: 与随机选择相比,SSU-Mag+TIES提供了更结构化的口罩,但在源保留和整体WER方面一般比SSU-Wanda+TIES差. 在所有三个基组中,SSU-Mag+TIES比SSU-Wanda+TIES造成更大的源降解,表明光是重量级不足以确定源的重要连接器方向. 通过融合源语言活化,SSU-Wanda生成了更保守的口罩来更好地保存原始多语言能力.

blocks.en: Overall, SSU-Wanda+TIES gives the most reliable source-preserving trade-off. It achieves the lowest source WER and lowest overall WER for all three base groups, although it sometimes gives up part of the target-language gain achieved by SSU-Rand or SSU-Mag. We therefore use SSU-Wanda as the default SSU criterion in the multi-target experiments.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,SSU-Wanda+TIES给出了最可靠的源保取取舍. 它实现了所有三个基组的最低源WER和最低的总WER,虽然它有时放弃了SSU-Rand或SSU-Mag实现的部分目标语言收益. 因此,我们使用SSU-Wanda作为多目标实验的默认SSU标准.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Base–Target Compatibility
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 基本目标兼容性

blocks.en: Table 4: Detailed single-target expansion WER (%) ↓ \downarrow for the Slavic base.
blocks.zh: 表4:斯拉夫语基础的单目标扩展情况

blocks.en: Finally, we examine whether expansion difficulty depends on the relationship between the base and target languages. Table 4 reports detailed single-target results for the Slavic base, which covers all compatibility types in our design. Full Germanic and Romance per-target results are reported in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 最后,我们审视扩张难度是否取决于基础语言和目标语言之间的关系. 表4详细列出斯拉夫语基础的单目标结果,涵盖了我们设计中的所有相容类型. 附录B.1报告了德国语和罗马语的每个目标结果。

blocks.en: The results show that base–target compatibility affects expansion behavior, but not through a simple ranking of conditions. Serbian is the most compatible target in our design, with both the same language group and script as the Slavic base, and is comparatively easy to add. SSU-Wanda+TIES reaches 27.63% target WER with only +4.17% source degradation. However, same-group targets are not uniformly easy. Polish and Slovenian are both Slavic languages using Latin script in our setting, but they are harder to add than Serbian, and Slovenian causes much larger source degradation.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,基础-目标相容性影响扩张行为,但不是通过简单的条件排序. 塞尔维亚语是我们设计中最相容的目标,语言组和脚本都与斯拉夫语基础相同,比较容易被添加. SSU-Wanda+TIES达到27.63%的目标WER,只有+4.17%的来源降解. 然而,同一组人的目标并不容易。 波兰语和斯洛文尼亚语都是斯拉夫语,

blocks.en: The comparison between Slovenian and Kyrgyz further shows that language-group match alone does not determine expansion difficulty. Slovenian is same-group but different-script, while Kyrgyz is different-group but same-script. Yet SSU-Wanda+TIES preserves source languages much better for Kyrgyz than for Slovenian, with +2.26% versus +21.11% source degradation, even though Kyrgyz remains difficult in target WER. This suggests that source retention and target learnability are related but not identical. A target can be hard to recognize while causing limited forgetting, or linguistically closer while producing a more disruptive update.
blocks.zh: 斯洛文尼亚语和吉尔吉斯语的比较进一步表明,仅靠语言组匹配并不能决定扩展难度. 斯洛维尼亚语为同组但有不同的拼写,而吉尔吉斯语为同组但有相同的拼写. 但SSU-Wanda+TIES保存的源语言对吉尔吉斯语比对斯洛文尼亚语要好得多,因为虽然吉尔吉斯语仍然难以在目标WER中降解,但+2.26%对+21.11%的源降解。 这表明来源保留和目标的可学习性相互关联,但并不相同。 目标可能很难识别,同时造成有限的遗忘,或语言上更接近,同时产生更具破坏性的更新。

blocks.en: These mixed patterns suggest that group and script compatibility influence expansion, but their effect depends on how the target update interacts with source-important connector directions.
blocks.zh: 这些混合模式暗示了组和脚本相容性会影响扩展,但其效果取决于目标更新如何与源重要连接器方向相互作用.

blocks.en: 4.3 Multi-Target Expansion
blocks.zh: 4.3 多目标扩展

The order is NO → \rightarrow IT → \rightarrow SR for Germanic and Romance, and IT → \rightarrow SR → \rightarrow PL → \rightarrow SL → \rightarrow KY for Slavic. blocks.en: 4.3.1 Joint Update Merging versus Recursive Adaptation
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 联合更新与递减适应

blocks.en: Joint update merging provides a stable source-preserving solution, while recursive adaptation can learn target languages more aggressively but is more order-sensitive. TIES keeps source WER close to the base connector for all three base groups and substantially improves target WER, reducing it from 102.70% to 64.93% for Germanic, from 111.16% to 67.22% for Romance, and from 110.15% to 97.41% for Slavic. This shows that independently trained target updates can be merged jointly without severe source-language forgetting.
blocks.zh: 联合更新合并提供了一个稳定的源保存解决方案,而再生适应则可以更积极地学习目标语言,但更注重顺序。 TIES将源WER保持了所有三个基组的基接器相近,并大幅度地改进了目标WER,将源WER从102.70%降至64.93%德意志语,从111.16%降至67.22%罗曼斯语,从110.15%降至97.41%斯拉夫语. 这表明,经过独立训练的目标更新可以合并而不会严重地忘记源语言.

blocks.en: Source-aware variants of joint merging do not uniformly improve target performance in the multi-target setting. Hard SSU+TIES and Incremental dynamic SSU further protect source languages, but often retain less target-language improvement than TIES. This suggests that source protection can become too restrictive when multiple target updates are combined.
blocks.zh: 联合合并的来源意识变体并不能统一改善多目标设定中的目标性能. 硬SSU+TIES和递增活性SSU进一步保护了源语言,但往往保留的目标语言改进少于TIES. 这表明当多个目标更新合并时,源保护可能变得限制性过强.

blocks.en: Recursive methods show a different trade-off. Recursive FT then SSU achieves the best target WER for Germanic and Slavic, and the best overall WER for Slavic under the configured order. However, its Romance result is much worse, indicating that recursive adaptation can produce stronger target learning but depends heavily on target order. Recursive rebased SSU is even less stable. Although it improves target WER in some settings, it causes large source degradation for Romance and Slavic, suggesting that recursively applying base-anchored target updates can accumulate source-language interference. Thus, unlike single-target expansion where SSU-Wanda+TIES is consistently strongest, multi-target expansion exposes a sharper trade-off between stable joint merging and order-sensitive recursive adaptation.
blocks.zh: 递归法显示取舍不同. 递归式FT再由SSU实现日耳曼语和斯拉夫语的最佳目标WER,在所配置的顺序下实现斯拉夫语的最好的整体WER. 然而,它的浪漫结果却更差,表明再生适应可以产生更强的目标学习,但严重依赖目标顺序. 递归再基于SSU的稳定性更低. 虽然它在某些环境中改进了目标WER,但它会给罗曼斯和斯拉维克带来巨大的源退化,说明递归性地应用碱-焦虑目标更新可以积累源语言干扰. 因此,与SSU-Wanda+TIES一贯最强的单目标扩展不同,多目标扩展暴露出稳定联合合并与对秩序敏感的回向适应之间的更尖锐取舍.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Recursive Order Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 递解顺序敏感性

blocks.en: Table 6: Final-stage WER (%) ↓ \downarrow for Recursive FT then SSU under different orders.
blocks.zh: 表 6: 最后阶段 WER (%)\\为递归FT的下限,然后根据不同的订单SSU.

blocks.en: Table 6 reports Recursive FT then SSU under all evaluated target orders. The results show strong order sensitivity, so the configured-order result in Table 5 should not be taken as the full capability of recursive adaptation.
blocks.zh: 表6 报告 递归FT然后在所有评估目标订单下的SSU. 结果显示出强烈的顺序敏感性,因此表5所配置的顺序结果不应被视为完全具有回转适应的能力.

blocks.en: For Romance, the configured order NO → \rightarrow IT → \rightarrow SR gives 57.81% overall WER, while IT → \rightarrow NO → \rightarrow SR improves it to 31.82%, outperforming TIES. Germanic shows a similar pattern, improving from 39.61% under the configured order to 35.05% with IT → \rightarrow SR → \rightarrow NO. For Slavic, Recursive FT then SSU already outperforms TIES under the configured order, but different orders still vary substantially, from 60.06% to 80.86% overall WER.
blocks.zh: 对罗曼斯来说,配置的指令NO → 右手IT → 右手SR给出了57.81%的整体WER,而IT → 右手NO → 右手SR则将其提升到31.82%,比TIES表现强. 日耳曼语呈现出类似的模式,在配置顺序下从39.61%提升到35.05%,使用IT →\右旋SR →\右旋NO. 对于斯拉夫语,递归FT然后SSU在所配置的顺序下已经超越了TIES,但不同的顺序仍然大相径庭,从60.06%到80.86%的总WER.

blocks.en: These results show that recursive adaptation is not simply worse than update merging. It is a higher-variance strategy that can achieve stronger target adaptation under favorable orders, but can also accumulate interference under poorly matched orders. This is consistent with the target-update conflict analysis in Appendix B.4 , where target updates show low cosine similarity and substantial sign disagreement. Overall, update merging is more stable and source-preserving, while recursive adaptation can achieve better overall WER when the target sequence is favorable.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,递归适应并不仅仅是更新合并的更糟糕. 它是一种较高的变相策略,可以在有利的命令下实现更强大的目标适应,但也可以在不匹配的命令下积累干扰. 这与附录B.4中的目标更新冲突分析是一致的,其中的目标更新显示的同心圆相似度低,并存在实质性的标志分歧. 总体而言,更新合并更加稳定并保持源头,而回溯适应可以在目标序列有利时实现更好的整体WER.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we studied source-aware expansion for connector-based multilingual ASR, where new languages are added while preserving the original base connector. Our results show that target fine-tuning and standard TIES merging learn new languages but often overwrite source-language performance, while SSU-Wanda+TIES gives the strongest single-target adaptation–retention trade-off. For multi-target expansion, update merging is stable and source-preserving, whereas recursive adaptation can achieve stronger target performance under favorable orders but is highly order-sensitive. Overall, effective multilingual ASR expansion requires both source-aware preservation and careful coordination among target-language updates.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们研究了基于连接器的多语种ASR的源认识扩展,其中在保留原始碱基连接器的同时添加了新的语言. 我们的结果显示,目标微调和标准TIES合并学习了新语言,但往往覆盖了源语言的性能,而SSU-Wanda+TIES则给出了最强的单目标调取舍。 对于多目标扩展,更新合并是稳定的并保留源,而回转适应可以在有利的命令下实现更强的目标性能,但对于命令非常敏感. 总的来说,有效的多语种ASR扩展既需要保持源头意识,也需要在目标语言更新之间进行认真协调。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en:
This work has two main limitations. First, our experiments focus on connector-based Speech LLMs, where the speech encoder and LLM are kept frozen and only the connector is adapted. This setting allows us to study parameter-selective adaptation and model merging in a controlled way, but the conclusions may not directly generalize to systems that update the speech encoder, the LLM, or the full ASR model during language expansion.
Second, our multi-target experiments cover a limited number of target languages and target orders. Although the results show clear order sensitivity in recursive expansion, we do not propose an automatic method for selecting the target order. A larger-scale study over more languages and principled order-selection strategies would be needed to fully characterize recursive multilingual expansion.
blocks.zh:
这项工作有两个主要局限。 首先,我们的实验侧重于基于连接器的Speech LLMs,其中语音编码器和LLM被冻结,只有连接器被调整. 这个设置允许我们以可控的方式研究参数选择性的适应和模型合并,但结论可能不会被直接概括到语言扩展过程中更新语音编码器,LLM,或全ASR模型的系统.
第二,我们的多目标实验涵盖有限数量的目标语言和目标订单. 虽然结果在递归性扩张中显示出明显的顺序敏感性,但我们不提议选择目标顺序的自动方法. 为了充分描述递归性多语种扩展的特点,需要针对更多语言和有原则的顺序选择战略进行更大规模的研究。

blocks.en: 7 Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 7 道德考虑

blocks.en: Our experiments use publicly available speech data from Common Voice, without collecting new recordings or additional speaker metadata. We do not disclose any personally identifiable information about the speakers. Multilingual ASR expansion may broaden access to speech technologies, but improvements for newly added languages can come at the expense of previously supported languages, potentially reducing service quality for their speakers. ASR adaptation methods may affect languages and speaker groups differently, and improvements in average WER can obscure these disparities. To make differences across languages visible, we report per-language performance on both source and target languages.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验使用公开的来自"共同之声"的语音数据,而不收集新的录音或额外的演讲者元数据. 我们不透露任何有关发言者的个人身份信息。 多语种的ASR扩展可能扩大语言技术的获取,但新增加语言的改进可能会牺牲以前得到支持的语言,有可能降低其发言者的服务质量. ASR的适应方法可能会对语言和演讲群体产生不同的影响,平均WER的改进可以掩盖这些差异. 为了使不同语言之间的差异明显可见,我们用源语言和目标语言报告每个语言的表现。

blocks.en: A.2 Expansion Protocols
blocks.zh: A.2 扩大议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate both single-target and multi-target expansion. In single-target expansion, each target language is added independently to a base connector, with base–target pairs covering language-group and script match/mismatch conditions (Table 2 ). We compare direct target fine-tuning, TIES without source-aware protection, and SSU variants using random, magnitude-based, and Wanda-based masking.
blocks.zh: 我们评价单一目标和多目标的扩展。 在单目标扩展中,每个目标语言被独立地添加到一个碱基连接器上,由碱基-目标对子覆盖语言组和脚本匹配/匹配条件(表2 ). 我们比较了直接目标微调,TIES没有源头意识的保护,以及SSU的变体使用随机的,量子的,和万达的口罩.

blocks.en: In multi-target expansion, we study how multiple target-language updates can form a single expanded connector. For joint update merging, target-specific connectors are independently adapted from the same base connector. Each target update is computed relative to that shared base, and the updates are merged without further gradient-based training. Recursive adaptation instead processes targets sequentially, using the connector produced by the preceding stage as the starting point for the next target. Each stage uses only the current target language for gradient-based training.
blocks.zh: 在多目标扩展中,我们研究多目标语言更新如何形成单一的扩展连接器. 对于联合更新合并,目标特定连接器从同个基接器独立改造. 每项目标更新都与该共享基数相对照进行计算,并且不进行以梯度为基础的进一步培训而合并更新。 递归性适应转而以相继为目标,利用前阶段产生的接线器作为下一个目标的起点. 每个阶段只使用目前的目标语言进行梯度培训。

blocks.en: The configured order is NO → \rightarrow IT → \rightarrow SR for the Germanic and Romance bases, and IT → \rightarrow SR → \rightarrow PL → \rightarrow SL → \rightarrow KY for the Slavic base. We additionally evaluate Recursive FT then SSU under the orders listed in Table 6 . These constitute the evaluated subset of possible orders rather than an exhaustive enumeration.
